import numpy as np, collections
from scipy.ndimage import label as lbl
def objs(m,bg):
    a=m!=bg; L,_=lbl(a); return [list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(L==k))) for k in range(1,int(L.max())+1)]
def try_slide(I,O,bg,order='topleft'):
    g=np.array(I); H,W=g.shape
    comps=objs(g,bg)
    if order=='righttoleft': comps=comps[::-1]
    occupied=set(); out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def conflict(cells):
        return any((r,c) in occupied for r,c in cells) or any(c==W-1 for r,c in cells)
    for cells in comps:
        cur=list(cells)
        d=0
        while True:
            cc=[(r,c+d) for r,c in cur]
            if conflict(cc): break
            cur=cc; d+=1
        occ=set(cur)
        occupied|=occ
        for r,c in cur: out[r][c]=O[r][c]
    ok=all(out[r][c]==O[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W))
    return ok,out
for name,bg in [('Demo pair 1',8),('Demo pair 2',6)]:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    for order in ['topleft','righttoleft']:
        print(name,'order',try_slide(I,O,bg,order)[0])

def comps(g):

    cs=comps(g,bg) if False else comps(g,bg)

        # find comp containing (i,j)

    shifts={}
    for ci,c in enumerate(cs):
        rs=[p[0] for p in c]; cols=[p[1] for p in c]
        bot=max(rs)

import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
